integrity: The result is algebraically proved and independently checked by exact finite graph enumeration; finite checks are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Requires fixed-size simple random graphs and an induced motif with no isolated vertices and at least one absent edge.
Positive expectations and a nontrivial isolate event require the displayed edge-count range.
Asymptotic first-order sign does not resolve density sequences tending to the exact critical value.
Possible earlier implicit result via hypergeometric counting; independent literature and mathematical audits outstanding.
title: A universal isolate–induced-motif covariance threshold in fixed-edge random graphs
